title.zh: XRPL fixes decade-old bug that could have minted trillions of XRP
title.en: XRPL fixes decade-old bug that could have minted trillions of XRP

current_state.zh: RippleX and the XRP Ledger Foundation disclosed a decade-old payment-engine overflow bug that could have let an attacker mint ~18 trillion XRP beyond the fixed supply, earning a $250,000 maximum bounty after being patched in xrpld 3.4.1 with over 80% of validators upgraded.
current_state.en: RippleX and the XRP Ledger Foundation disclosed a decade-old payment-engine overflow bug that could have let an attacker mint ~18 trillion XRP beyond the fixed supply, earning a $250,000 maximum bounty after being patched in xrpld 3.4.1 with over 80% of validators upgraded.
